verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a headless orchestration engine by design: workers run as background processes (hatchet worker dev / production worker run), SDKs exist for Python/TypeScript/Go/Ruby for scripted automation, and self-hosting/control-plane docs plus cron/scheduled runs support CI-driven and unattended execution. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) and independent confirmation of headless CI usage beyond docs.
